sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate represents the required relationship or path from a main frame to its strengthened part; hasLowerEnd alone would preserve the incorrect direct application, and frameEnd denotes the overall frame end.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Retarget the lower-end constraint directly to nltl:mainFrame and nltl:intermediateIceFrame rather than nltl:transverseFrame with an inner rdf:type gate, which otherwise lets frames lacking an explicit transverseFrame type escape validation. Keep the connection alternative exclusive to intermediate ice frames, preferably with separate shapes/branches, and require the horizontal member to connect to both adjacent main frames (at least two distinct nltl:mainFrame values), not merely one. Retain the direct-attachment alternative and the separate main-frame-below-ice-belt strengthening check.

The main-frame constraint incorrectly applies hasLowerEnd directly to every mainFrame, whereas the requirement concerns the lower end of the strengthened part of a main frame. Locate and use the canonical relationship/path from a main frame to its strengthened part, then constrain that part’s relevant lower end; do not substitute the overall frame end. Retain the separate below-ice-belt strengthening requirement and the intermediate-frame direct/conditional alternatives.
